title: Cosmic Knowledge Spiral
description: A surreal circular composition featuring a glowing golden vortex at the center of a swirling spiral tunnel lined with ancient scripts and runes. The outer ring is densely populated with clusters of organic, mossy, and crystalline orbs in varying shades of green, teal, and purple against a dark background.
